purpose: A synthetic task-domain overlay for structured professional work. It is not a personal profile.

excluded_uses: Do not treat this profile as identity, biography, or user-preference data.
Do not authorize external actions or override host permissions.

workflow_steps.objective: Identify the requested result, constraints, exclusions, and acceptance criteria.
Create or revise the requested artifact within the declared scope.
Run proportionate checks and report exactly what was and was not verified.

verification_requirements: Separate planned work from executed work and verified results.
Run relevant deterministic tests when code or schemas change.
Do not infer semantic truth from structural validation alone.
additive_constraints: Keep task-local context separate from durable personal data.
Preserve unknowns and unresolved contradictions when material.
